item.description: [Bloomberg] 由于美国和伊朗重新爆发敌对行动，加剧了人们对霍尔木兹海峡能源流动长期中断的担忧，石油价格创下 7 月份以来的最大单周涨幅。 彭博社的 Onur Ant 带来了最新消息。 （来源：彭博社）

item.title: Maniatis: Hormuz Escalation Risk Has Eased
item.description: [Bloomberg] Dimitris Maniatis, CEO of Marisks, says the latest intelligence assessment has reduced expectations of a near-term escalation in the Strait of Hormuz, after earlier analysis pointed to heightened risk. He says 25 ships transited the southern corridor under U.S. military guidance the previous day and vessel movements are continuing. Maniatis also says attractive earnings are drawing shipowners back to the route, while crews remain cautious but are willing to transit with bonuses, security support and proper risk assessments. He speaks with Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East and Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: South Africa’s IDC to Sell Its Stake in Namibian Uranium Mine
